Title: Ekom Algolia
Description: Algolia search for Ekom stores. It indexes products, categories and Umbraco content in the background, adds search services for all three, and sends Algolia Insights events for views, add-to-cart, checkout and purchases.

AuthorDetails.Name: Vettvangur
AuthorDetails.Description: Vettvangur is a digital agency in Iceland that builds and maintains Ekom.

RelatedPackages.Description: The Ekom e-commerce package that this integration extends.
